scenario.note: The rule ensures that at most two of the three specified foods have a positive ration per person. The sum of ration over these foods is bounded by zero, meaning at most two can be positive (and the third or more must be zero).

The rule ensures that for at most one of the foods Maize meal, Oil, and Milk, the purchase is above zero. This is interpreted as a constraint that at most one food in this set has a positive purchase amount.
Only three of the five suppliers may have any food purchased; the rule sets purchase to zero for the other two.
Only three suppliers (Daraa, Hassakeh, Aleppo, Gaziantep and Amman) are allowed to have positive purchases; others must have zero purchase.
The ration of milk at Idleb must be either zero or at least 2.15 units per person per day.
